## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
